nodes.description: Address of the contract owner, set to msg.sender at deployment; used by the onlyOwner access control check.
Pending owner address used in the two-step ownership transfer flow.
Token symbol string, set to TOKYO in the constructor.
Token name string, set to TOKYO.hodlcities.com in the constructor.
Token decimals, set to 18 in the constructor.
Total token supply, assigned in the constructor and read by totalSupply().
Mapping of holder address to token balance, mutated by transfer/transferFrom and read by balanceOf.
Nested mapping owner=>spender=>amount storing ERC20 allowances, written by approve/approveAndCall/transferFrom.
Addition with a manual overflow guard (require c >= a); used by Tokyo transfers.
Subtraction with an underflow guard (require b <= a); used by Tokyo transfers.
Multiplication with an overflow guard (require a == 0 || c / a == b).
Division with a divide-by-zero guard (require b > 0).
Initializes owner with msg.sender, granting the deployer ownership privileges.
onlyOwner function that sets newOwner, the first step of ownership transfer.
Second step of ownership transfer; requires msg.sender == newOwner and moves ownership.
Sets symbol/name/decimals/_totalSupply and pre-mints the whole supply to a fixed address.
Returns _totalSupply minus balances[address(0)].
Read-only balance lookup in the balances mapping.
ERC20 transfer from msg.sender to 'to' using safeSub/safeAdd on balances.
Sets allowed[msg.sender][spender] = tokens, allowing an unlimited/double-spend pattern.
Moves tokens from 'from' to 'to' and decreases the caller's allowance using safeSub/safeAdd.
Read-only allowance lookup in the allowed mapping.
Sets allowance then performs an arbitrary external call to ApproveAndCallFallBack(spender).receiveApproval, enabling reentrancy/callbacks into arbitrary attacker code.
Payable fallback that always reverts, rejecting plain ETH transfers.
onlyOwner function that performs an arbitrary external ERC20 transfer call to a user-supplied tokenAddress.
Caller-controlled address used for ownership checks, balance debits and allowance keys.
External call ApproveAndCallFallBack(spender).receiveApproval(...) to a caller-supplied contract after state changes, enabling reentrancy.
External call ERC20Interface(tokenAddress).transfer(owner, tokens) to an arbitrary, caller-supplied contract address.
Integer addition a + b in safeAdd, guarded by the require(c >= a) overflow check.
Integer subtraction a - b in safeSub, guarded by the require(b <= a) underflow check.
Integer multiplication a * b in safeMul, guarded by the require(a == 0 || c / a == b) overflow check.
Integer division a / b in safeDiv, guarded by the require(b > 0) divide-by-zero check.

edges.reason: The deployer-controlled msg.sender is written into owner, establishing privileged access rights.
msg.sender identifies the account whose balance is debited in transfer.
msg.sender is used as the outer key when writing allowed[msg.sender][spender] in approve.
msg.sender is used as the allowance spender key in transferFrom.
msg.sender is used as the allowance owner key and is forwarded to receiveApproval in approveAndCall.
The onlyOwner modifier compares msg.sender against owner before allowing transferOwnership.
acceptOwnership requires msg.sender == newOwner to finalize the ownership handover.
The onlyOwner modifier guards the external call in transferAnyERC20Token against non-owners.
The 'to' parameter determines the credited balance in transfer.
The 'tokens' parameter is the amount debited/credited in transfer.
The spender parameter is the inner key of the allowance write in approve.
The tokens parameter is the allowance value written in approve.
The 'from' parameter is the debited account in transferFrom.
The 'to' parameter is the credited account in transferFrom.
The 'tokens' parameter is the moved amount in transferFrom.
The caller-supplied spender parameter determines the contract targeted by the external call in approveAndCall.
The tokens parameter is written into the allowance and forwarded to receiveApproval.
The raw bytes parameter is forwarded unvalidated into the external receiveApproval call.
The tokenAddress parameter selects the arbitrary contract targeted by the external transfer call.
The tokens parameter is the amount passed to the external transfer call.
The tokenOwner parameter indexes the balances mapping in balanceOf.
transfer reads and writes the balances mapping for both sender and recipient.
transferFrom updates the balances mapping for 'from' and 'to'.
transferFrom decreases allowed[from][msg.sender] by the transferred amount.
approve writes the caller's allowance for the spender into the allowed mapping.
approveAndCall writes the allowance into the allowed mapping before making the external call.
The constructor pre-mints the entire supply into balances of the fixed deployer address.
The constructor assigns _totalSupply.
The constructor assigns the symbol state variable.
The constructor assigns the name state variable.
The constructor assigns the decimals state variable.
The constructor writes msg.sender into the owner state variable.
transferOwnership stages the new owner in the newOwner state variable.
acceptOwnership promotes newOwner to owner, changing privileged access.
acceptOwnership clears newOwner to address(0) after the handover.
balanceOf returns the value read from the balances mapping.
allowance returns the value read from the allowed mapping.
totalSupply returns _totalSupply minus the zero-address balance.
totalSupply subtracts balances[address(0)] from _totalSupply.
transferAnyERC20Token uses the privileged owner address as the destination of the recovered tokens.
transfer performs its balance subtraction through SafeMath.safeSub.
transfer performs its balance addition through SafeMath.safeAdd.
transferFrom performs balance and allowance subtractions through SafeMath.safeSub.
transferFrom performs the recipient credit through SafeMath.safeAdd.
approveAndCall invokes an external contract's receiveApproval with caller-controlled address and calldata.
The external receiveApproval call can re-enter the token contract before approveAndCall returns, enabling reentrancy.
transferAnyERC20Token calls an arbitrary token contract supplied by the caller, letting a malicious contract control execution.
The arbitrary external transfer call executes attacker-controlled code that can re-enter the privileged function.
safeAdd performs the raw integer addition a + b guarded by require(c >= a).
safeSub performs the raw integer subtraction a - b guarded by require(b <= a).
safeMul performs the raw integer multiplication a * b guarded by an overflow check.
safeDiv performs the raw integer division a / b guarded by require(b > 0).

The 'tokens' parameter is only used by Tokyo.transfer and should be merged into that core function node.

The 'tokens' parameter is used only inside Tokyo.transferFrom and should be merged into it.
The spender parameter directly selects the target of the external call made by Tokyo.approveAndCall.
The tokens parameter is consumed by Tokyo.approveAndCall for the allowance write.
The data parameter is forwarded by Tokyo.approveAndCall into the external callback.
The tokenAddress parameter is the arbitrary call target of Tokyo.transferAnyERC20Token.
The tokens parameter is the amount forwarded by Tokyo.transferAnyERC20Token.
The tokenOwner parameter is only an index into the balances read performed by Tokyo.balanceOf.
